synthesis.body: Never wire a lint into tools/hooks/pre-pr.py: it's PROJECTED to adopters (sourced from packs/core/.apm/hooks/pre-pr.py), so it would call a script absent from their tree. That principle stands. But the corollary 'linters don't project, so they must be catalogue-only in tools/' is FALSE (RFC-0016 originally claimed it; corrected in RFC-0016 § Errata + ADR-0007). A skill's scripts/ folder DOES project to every adapter and already ships governance Python (work-loop/scripts/loop-cohort.py, new-adr/new-rfc scripts/next-ordinal.py). The doc-drift spec-metadata lint now lives at packs/core/.apm/skills/work-loop/scripts/lint-spec-status.py — agent-invoked at the work-loop finish-time checklist (available, not fail-closed), AND run by the catalogue as a fail-closed CI gate via `make build-check` against the PROJECTED .claude/ copy (mirrors how pre-pr.py invokes projected loop-cohort.py). Also: adding a file under packs/core/seeds/ changes the `core` install snapshot — regenerate with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 pytest tests/integration/test_install_snapshot.py.

title: Don't wire any lint into the projected pre-pr.py; a lint CAN ship to adopters as a skill script
